artworks.title: Zeus Battling Typhon (Chalcidian Black-Figure Hydria, Side B)
artworks.description: The canonical ancient image of the Typhonomachy on a Chalcidian hydria in Munich: Zeus strides forward to hurl his thunderbolt against a winged, snake-legged Typhon whose lower body coils into serpents — Hesiod's youngest child of Gaia and Tartarus (Theogony 820–868), blasted down a maimed wreck when the new order of Zeus was tested one last time.
